# Patio seating

The Cove four-seat set uses powder-coated aluminum frames and solution-dyed acrylic covers. The table is 92 cm square and 41 cm high. Cushion covers are water resistant, not waterproof, and should be stored indoors during prolonged rain or frost.

# Care

Rinse salt or chlorine residue with fresh water. Do not pressure wash the frames. A breathable cover may be used only when the furniture is dry. The set is not intended for commercial hospitality use.
